where.description: Conjunction of predicates {field, op, value}. op: eq ne lt lte gt gte in not_in is_null not_null. value is a JSON literal typed by the field: strings raw (EMEA, never 'EMEA'), numbers, booleans, ISO-8601 timestamps as plain strings. Relative time: {"expr":"now() - 1h"} (the bare string "now() - 1h" is also accepted). Landed sources need a gt/gte lower bound on their time column.
where.title: maxItems(32)

patternProperties.description: a string at most 200 character(s) long
patternProperties.title: maxLength(200)

derive.description: Map of new field name to expression over fields. Operators + - * / = != < <= > >= and or not. Functions: now(), abs(x), ms(duration) -> int ms, round(x, n), coalesce(a, b), date_trunc(1h, ts), bucket(ts, '1 minute') (units second/minute/hour/day). timestamp - timestamp yields a duration in MILLISECONDS. Duration literals: 90s 15m 1h 3d. Example: {"latency_ms":"ms(fulfilled_at - placed_at)","minute":"bucket(placed_at, '1 minute')"}. Group by a derived name to bucket time.

group.description: an array of at most 8 item(s)
group.title: maxItems(8)

aggregate.description: Map of output name to aggregate. Object form (canonical): {"fn":"percentile","of":"latency_ms","p":0.95}, {"fn":"count"}, {"fn":"avg","of":"latency_ms"}; fn is count count_distinct sum avg min max percentile. String alias: "percentile(latency_ms, 0.95)", "count()", "sum(order_value_cents)".

select.description: an array of at most 64 item(s)
select.title: maxItems(64)

order.description: an array of at most 8 item(s)
order.title: maxItems(8)

anyOf.description: an array of at most 100 item(s)
anyOf.title: maxItems(100)

value.description: A JSON literal typed by the field: strings raw (EMEA, not 'EMEA'), numbers, booleans, timestamps as ISO-8601 strings (2026-11-20T14:00:00Z). Relative time: {"expr":"now() - 1h"}. "in"/"not_in" take an array.

expr.description: a string at most 200 character(s) long
expr.title: maxLength(200)

anyOf.title: maxLength(200)

of.description: a string at most 200 character(s) long
of.title: maxLength(200)
